title: Korean-Style Crispy Chicken with Sweet Spicy Glaze
summary: Crisp, golden chicken pieces tossed in a sticky Korean-inspired sweet chilli glaze with garlic, ginger and sesame. It is a satisfying dinner to serve with rice and quick vegetables.

ingredients.name: boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Pat the chicken dry with kitchen paper. In a large bowl, mix the cornstarch, plain flour, salt and black pepper, then toss in the chicken until every piece is well coated.

Heat the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Fry the chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, turning occasionally, until deep golden, crisp and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper or a wire rack.

While the chicken cooks, put the garlic, ginger, sriracha, soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, rice vinegar and sesame oil in a small saucepan. Simmer for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until glossy and slightly thickened.
Tip the crispy chicken into a large clean bowl. Pour over the hot glaze and toss quickly until the pieces are evenly coated but still crisp at the edges.
Scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onions, then serve immediately, ideally with steamed rice.
